neet-ug.name: NEET-UG
neet-ug.eligibility: Class 12 with Physics, Chemistry, Biology and English. About 50% in PCB for General (40% for reserved categories). Age 17 or more by 31 December of the admission year.
neet-ug.leads: MBBS, BDS, AYUSH, BVSc and several allied courses
neet-ug.simple: The big test to become a doctor or a dentist.

kcet.name: KCET (Karnataka)
kcet.marking: 1 mark each, no negative marking, 80 minutes per paper
kcet.eligibility: 2nd PUC or Class 12 with Physics, Chemistry and Maths or Biology. About 45% for General, 40% for reserved categories. Rank uses 50% KCET and 50% PUC marks.
kcet.leads: Engineering, B.Pharm, BSc Nursing, agriculture seats in Karnataka
kcet.simple: Karnataka's test for engineering, pharmacy and nursing seats.

cuet-ug.name: CUET-UG
cuet-ug.total: Up to 5 subjects including language and general test
cuet-ug.eligibility: Class 12 pass. Each university sets its own subject combination.
cuet-ug.leads: BSc, BCom, BA and other degrees at central and many state universities
cuet-ug.simple: One test that opens the door to many university degrees.

iiser-iat.name: IISER Aptitude Test (IAT)
iiser-iat.eligibility: Class 12 Science with at least three of Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Maths. Minimum 60% (55% for SC/ST/PwD).
iiser-iat.simple: A test to join IISER, the science research colleges.

jee-main.name: JEE Main
jee-main.marking: +4 for correct, -1 for wrong MCQ. Check the bulletin for numerical questions.
jee-main.eligibility: Class 12 passed or appearing. No minimum percentage to appear. NITs and IIITs usually ask for about 75% in Class 12 or a top 20 percentile.
jee-main.leads: NITs, IIITs, other engineering colleges, JEE Advanced for IITs
jee-main.simple: The test to join NITs and many engineering colleges.

bitsat.name: BITSAT
rows: Physics, Chemistry, Maths, English, Logical reasoning
bitsat.eligibility: Class 12 with Physics, Chemistry, Maths and English. High aggregate and per-subject minimums apply, so check the brochure.
bitsat.leads: BE and BTech at BITS campuses
bitsat.simple: The entry test for BITS Pilani, a top engineering college.

nda.name: NDA and NA (UPSC)
nda.marking: Negative marking of one-third in the written papers
nda.eligibility: Class 12 pass. Army wing: any stream. Air Force and Navy: Physics and Maths. Unmarried, about 16.5 to 19.5 years of age.
nda.leads: Army, Navy and Air Force officer training with a degree
nda.simple: The test to join the Army, Navy or Air Force after Class 12.

nata.name: NATA (Architecture)
nata.mode: Drawing test and online aptitude test, 3 hours
nata.eligibility: Class 12 with Physics and Maths. About 45% aggregate for the Council of Architecture. Colleges often ask more.
nata.simple: A drawing and thinking test to study architecture.

ca-foundation.name: CA Foundation (ICAI)
ca-foundation.body: Institute of Chartered Accountants of India
ca-foundation.total: 400 marks. Papers 1 and 2 are descriptive, 3 and 4 are objective.
ca-foundation.marking: 0.25 negative in the objective papers. Pass needs 40% in each paper and 50% overall.
ca-foundation.eligibility: Class 12 pass. Register at least four months before the exam.
ca-foundation.simple: The first exam on the way to becoming a Chartered Accountant.

cseet.name: CSEET (ICSI)
cseet.body: Institute of Company Secretaries of India
cseet.total: Revised pattern reported as four 100-mark papers
cseet.simple: The entry test to become a Company Secretary.

cma-foundation.name: CMA Foundation (ICMAI)
cma-foundation.body: Institute of Cost Accountants of India
cma-foundation.marking: Pass needs 40% in each paper and 50% overall
cma-foundation.eligibility: Class 12 pass, or appearing with provisional registration.
cma-foundation.simple: The first exam on the way to becoming a Cost Accountant.

ipmat.name: IPMAT (IIM Indore and Rohtak)
ipmat.eligibility: Class 12 passed or appearing. Age and percentage rules differ for Indore and Rohtak, so check each.
ipmat.simple: A test to join IIM and study management for 5 years.

clat.name: CLAT (UG)
clat.eligibility: Class 12 or equivalent, appearing candidates allowed. About 45% (40% for SC/ST).
clat.leads: BA LLB at National Law Universities and many private law schools
clat.simple: The test to join law universities.

sof-olympiads.name: Olympiads by SOF (Science, Maths, English)
sof-olympiads.simple: Fun school-level contests in Science, Maths and English. Good practice for big exams later.
sof-olympiads.month: October to December, second round in February
sof-olympiads.total: Check the SOF notice for the number of questions
sof-olympiads.eligibility: Students from Class 1 to 12. Schools register their students.
sof-olympiads.leads: Confidence and practice for later exams

ioqm.name: Maths Olympiad (IOQM, RMO, INMO)
ioqm.simple: A Maths contest with three steps. Go through all three and you can reach the international Maths Olympiad.
ioqm.month: IOQM in September, RMO in November, INMO in January
ioqm.eligibility: Students in Class 8 to 12 who meet the age rule on the HBCSE brochure.

nmms.name: NMMS scholarship test
nmms.simple: A test in Class 8 that can win you a scholarship for Class 9 to 12.
nmms.month: January or February (apply in September or October)
nmms.total: About 12,000 per year for Class 9 to 12
nmms.eligibility: Class 8 students of government, aided and local body schools. Family income limit and Class 7 marks apply.

aissee.name: Sainik School test (AISSEE)
aissee.simple: A test to join a Sainik School in Class 6 or Class 9. These schools prepare you for the Army, Navy and Air Force.
aissee.eligibility: Class 6: age 10 to 12. Class 9: age 13 to 15. Boys and girls can apply.
aissee.leads: Sainik School, then NDA and other defence entries

nsejs.name: Junior Science Olympiad (NSEJS)
nsejs.simple: A Science contest for Class 9 and 10 with Physics, Chemistry and Biology. Winners go to the next round.
nsejs.eligibility: Students in Class 9 and 10. Age rule applies.

ntse.name: NTSE
ntse.simple: A national talent test in Class 10. Winners get a scholarship.
ntse.eligibility: Class 10 students. The 2026-27 notice is still awaited.

upsc-cse.leads: IAS, IPS, IFS and other services
upsc-cse.name: UPSC Civil Services Exam
upsc-cse.simple: The big exam to become an IAS, IPS or other civil service officer.
upsc-cse.eligibility: A degree in any subject. Age 21 to 32 for General (6 attempts). Final-year students can apply.

ctet-kartet.leads: Government and private school teaching jobs
ctet-kartet.name: CTET and KARTET (teacher tests)
ctet-kartet.body: CBSE (CTET) and Karnataka School Education Department (KARTET)
ctet-kartet.simple: The test to become a government school teacher.
ctet-kartet.month: February and September. KARTET is usually in December
ctet-kartet.eligibility: Paper 1: Class 12 with 50% and a diploma in elementary education. Paper 2: a degree and a B.Ed.

uceed.mode: Computer test plus a drawing test
uceed.marking: Part A has partial negative marking
uceed.leads: B.Des at IITs and some other institutes
uceed.name: UCEED (IIT design test)
uceed.simple: The test to study design at the IITs.
uceed.eligibility: Any stream in Class 12. Born on or after 1 October 2002 (relaxation for SC/ST/PwD).

nid-dat.mode: Prelims, then a studio test and interview
nid-dat.pattern: Prelims first, then Mains with studio tests and an interview.
nid-dat.leads: B.Des at NID campuses, including Bengaluru
nid-dat.name: NID DAT
nid-dat.simple: The test to study design at NID.
nid-dat.eligibility: Class 12 in any stream. No upper age limit.

nift.mode: Ability tests, then a situation test or interview for some courses
nift.name: NIFT entrance
nift.body: NIFT with the National Testing Agency
nift.simple: The test for fashion and design colleges.
nift.month: Early in the year (check the NIFT notice)
nift.eligibility: B.Des: any stream. B.FTech: Maths needed. Age under 24.

ncet.leads: ITEP: BA B.Ed or BSc B.Ed
ncet.name: NCET (teacher degree test)
ncet.simple: The test to join a 4-year teacher degree.

liberal-tests.pattern: FLAME: its own test plus an essay, or SAT or ACT with an essay. Ashoka: an aptitude test and an on-the-spot essay. Azim Premji: its own entrance test and interview.
liberal-tests.name: Liberal arts university tests
liberal-tests.body: FLAME, Ashoka and Azim Premji University
liberal-tests.simple: Each liberal arts university has its own entry test.
liberal-tests.month: Winter and spring (each university sets dates)

ailet.name: AILET (NLU Delhi law test)
ailet.simple: The law entrance test for NLU Delhi.

rows: English, GK, Legal reasoning, Logical reasoning, Quant
slat.leads: BA LLB at private law schools
slat.name: SLAT and private law tests
slat.simple: Private law schools have their own tests.

aibe.mode: Paper test, open book, 3 hours 30 minutes
aibe.leads: Certificate of Practice, so you can work as an advocate
aibe.name: AIBE (Bar exam)
aibe.simple: The exam you must pass to work as a lawyer.
aibe.month: June and November (2026: 7 June and 29 November)
aibe.eligibility: A law degree (3-year or 5-year LLB). Final-year students can register.

civil-judge.pattern: Prelims, Mains and an Interview. The pattern differs by state.
civil-judge.name: Civil Judge exam
civil-judge.body: State Public Service Commissions with the High Courts
civil-judge.simple: The exam to become a judge.
civil-judge.eligibility: A law degree. Age and years of practice differ by state.

agniveer.mode: Entrance exam, then fitness and medical tests
agniveer.pattern: A common entrance exam, then physical and medical tests. The pattern differs by post.
agniveer.leads: 4 years of service. About a quarter of each batch can stay on.
agniveer.name: Agniveer (Army, Navy, Air Force)
agniveer.body: Indian Army, Navy and Air Force
agniveer.simple: A 4-year job as a soldier, sailor or airman after Class 8, 10 or 12.
agniveer.eligibility: Age 17.5 to 21. General Duty: Class 10 with 45%. Technical: Class 12 with PCM and English. Tradesman: Class 8 or 10.

army-tes.pattern: Shortlist by JEE Main rank, then an SSB interview and medical tests.
army-tes.leads: 4 years of engineering training, then Army officer
army-tes.name: Army 10+2 Technical Entry (TES)
army-tes.simple: Join the Army after Class 12 and study engineering.
army-tes.eligibility: Class 12 with PCM (60%). JEE Main score needed. Unmarried male. Age about 16.5 to 19.5.

navy-btech.pattern: Shortlist by JEE Main rank, then an SSB interview and medical tests.
navy-btech.leads: BTech at the Indian Naval Academy, then Navy officer
navy-btech.name: Navy 10+2 BTech entry
navy-btech.simple: Join the Navy after Class 12 and study BTech at the Naval Academy.
navy-btech.month: Applications open mid-year (2026: 29 May to 18 June)
navy-btech.eligibility: Class 12 with 70% in PCM and 50% in English. JEE Main score needed. Unmarried.

cds.total: Then an SSB interview and medical tests
cds.marking: Negative marking in the written test
cds.leads: Training at IMA, INA, AFA or OTA
cds.name: CDS (Combined Defence Services)
cds.simple: The test to become an officer after a degree.
cds.eligibility: Unmarried graduates. Age about 19 to 24 (25 for OTA).

afcat.leads: Air Force officer (flying or ground duty)
afcat.name: AFCAT (Air Force)
afcat.simple: The test to become an Air Force officer after a degree.
afcat.eligibility: Graduates. Flying branch age 20 to 24. Flying needs Maths and Physics in Class 12.

rows: Days 3 and 4: Group tasks and interview
ssb.leads: Academy training and a commission as an officer
ssb.name: SSB interview (5 days)
ssb.simple: A 5-day test of how you think, lead and work in a team.
ssb.frequency: After each written test or entry route
ssb.eligibility: You must first clear the entry route (NDA, CDS, AFCAT, TES, Navy BTech or NCC).

nchm-jee.pattern: Computer-based test of about 3 hours. Check the NTA bulletin for the sections.
nchm-jee.leads: BSc Hospitality at Institutes of Hotel Management such as IHM Bangalore
nchm-jee.name: NCHM JEE (Hotel Management)
nchm-jee.simple: The test to study hotel management.
nchm-jee.eligibility: Class 12 in any stream with English. No age limit.

igrua.pattern: Entrance test, then an interview and medical tests. See the IGRUA prospectus.
igrua.name: IGRUA test (pilot school)
igrua.simple: A test to join a pilot school.
igrua.eligibility: Class 12 with Physics, Maths and English, about 50% (45% for reserved categories). A Class 1 medical fitness certificate is needed.

rows: Physics, Chemistry, Maths, English, General Aptitude (BTech paper)
imu-cet.total: About 200 questions for the BTech paper
imu-cet.leads: BTech Marine Engineering and BSc Nautical Science
imu-cet.name: IMU CET (Merchant Navy)
imu-cet.simple: The test to study to be a ship officer.
imu-cet.eligibility: Class 12 with 60% in PCM and 50% in English. Medical fitness is needed.

ifos.pattern: Prelims is shared with the Civil Services exam. Mains is separate.
ifos.name: Indian Forest Service (IFoS)
ifos.simple: The exam to become a senior forest officer.
ifos.month: Prelims with the Civil Services Prelims (May)
ifos.eligibility: A degree in Agriculture, Forestry or Engineering, or a science subject such as Botany, Zoology, Physics or Chemistry. Age 21 to 32.

dte-diploma.pattern: Seats are given by counselling. Check the DTE Karnataka notice for the exact rules.
dte-diploma.leads: 3-year diploma in engineering and other branches
dte-diploma.name: Polytechnic diploma admission
dte-diploma.eligibility: SSLC (Class 10) pass. Science and Maths are needed for most branches.

dcet.pattern: Check the KEA notice for the pattern.
dcet.leads: BE or BTech in 3 more years
dcet.name: DCET (join engineering in 2nd year)
dcet.simple: After a diploma, you can join BE in the second year.
dcet.eligibility: Diploma holders (and some others, as listed by KEA).

iti-admission.pattern: Admission is by marks. Trades take 6 months to 2 years.
iti-admission.name: ITI admission
iti-admission.body: Karnataka Directorate of Employment and Training
iti-admission.simple: Learn a trade such as electrician or fitter.
iti-admission.eligibility: Class 8 pass for some trades, Class 10 pass for others.

pmkvy.pattern: Short courses linked to national skill levels (NSQF).
pmkvy.leads: A skill certificate and entry-level jobs
pmkvy.name: PMKVY (Skill India courses)
pmkvy.simple: Short skill courses with a certificate.
pmkvy.eligibility: Age about 15 to 59 as listed. Check each course.

inspire-manak.pattern: Your school nominates up to 5 ideas. Winners go from district to state to national level.
inspire-manak.leads: An award of 10,000 and a start in innovation
inspire-manak.name: INSPIRE-MANAK idea awards
inspire-manak.simple: Share a new idea and win an award.
inspire-manak.month: Schools nominate in July to September

khelo-india.pattern: You do not apply. Athletes are picked through trials and games and register on the NSRS portal.
khelo-india.leads: About 6.28 lakh a year for training and costs (reported)
khelo-india.name: Khelo India Athlete Scholarship
khelo-india.simple: Money and coaching for young athletes.
khelo-india.month: After the Khelo India Youth Games and trials
khelo-india.eligibility: Athletes in Class 9 to 12, college and postgraduate. Support for up to 8 years.

lnipe-bped.pattern: CUET-UG registration, then a fitness test and a sports skill test, as in the 2026-27 notice.
lnipe-bped.name: BPEd at LNIPE Gwalior
lnipe-bped.body: Lakshmibai National Institute of Physical Education

bfa-admission.pattern: Many colleges admit by Class 12 marks. Some ask for a portfolio or a test.
bfa-admission.name: BFA and art college admission
bfa-admission.body: Karnataka Chitrakala Parishath and other colleges
bfa-admission.simple: Join an art college to paint, draw or design.

jee-advanced.name: JEE Advanced (IITs)
jee-advanced.body: One of the seven IITs in turn (IIT Roorkee in 2026)
jee-advanced.simple: The test for the IITs. You must do well in JEE Main first.
jee-advanced.pattern: Two compulsory papers of 3 hours each, covering Physics, Chemistry and Maths. Marking changes by question type and by year.
jee-advanced.marking: Changes every year. Read the official brochure.
jee-advanced.eligibility: Be among the top 2,50,000 candidates of JEE Main (BE/BTech). Class 12 first appeared no earlier than the previous year. At most 2 attempts in 2 years in a row.
jee-advanced.leads: IITs and related institutes through JoSAA counselling

comedk.name: COMEDK UGET
comedk.simple: The test for many private engineering colleges in Karnataka.
comedk.eligibility: Class 12 or 2nd PUC with Physics, Chemistry, Maths and English. About 45% marks for General category.†
comedk.leads: BE and BTech seats in COMEDK member colleges

nest.name: NEST (NISER and CEBS)
nest.body: NISER Bhubaneswar and UM-DAE CEBS Mumbai
nest.simple: The test for the 5-year integrated MSc at NISER and CEBS.
nest.pattern: Computer based test with sections on general science, biology, chemistry, physics and maths. Check the official notice for marking.
nest.eligibility: Class 12 Science with good marks (about 60% for General category).†
nest.leads: 5-year integrated MSc in science at NISER and UM-DAE CEBS

acet.name: ACET (Actuarial Entrance Test)
acet.simple: The first step to become an actuary, who works with risk and numbers.
acet.pattern: 70 multiple-choice questions in 3 hours on Maths, Statistics, Data Interpretation, English and Logical Reasoning. The score is valid for 3 years.
acet.eligibility: Class 12 pass or appearing. Check the IAI notice for the subject rules.†
acet.leads: The actuary route and BSc Statistics or Actuarial Science

cmi-isi.name: CMI and ISI entrance tests
cmi-isi.body: Chennai Mathematical Institute and Indian Statistical Institute
cmi-isi.simple: Tests for top colleges in maths, statistics and computer science.
cmi-isi.month: May (2026: CMI on 2 May, ISI on 10 May)
cmi-isi.pattern: CMI test: Part A objective (40 marks) and Part B written answers (80 marks).† ISI test: maths based. Check each institute for the latest pattern.
cmi-isi.eligibility: Class 12 pass. ISI wants Maths and English in Class 12. CMI has no minimum percentage.
cmi-isi.leads: BSc Maths or Computer Science at CMI, B.Stat and B.Math at ISI

private-engg.name: VITEEE, SRMJEEE and other private tests
private-engg.simple: Many private universities run their own engineering tests.
private-engg.pattern: Dates and patterns differ for each university. Check each one.†
private-engg.eligibility: Class 12 with Physics, Chemistry and Maths. Each university sets its own marks rule.
private-engg.leads: BE and BTech at private universities

set-npat.name: SET, NPAT and college tests
set-npat.body: Symbiosis, NMIMS, Christ and other colleges
set-npat.simple: Entrance tests for BBA and BMS at private colleges.
set-npat.pattern: Each college has its own test and dates. Registration windows change every year.†
set-npat.eligibility: Class 12 pass or appearing. Each college sets its own rules.

rimc.name: RIMC entrance (Class 8)
rimc.simple: A military college school you can join in Class 8.
rimc.pattern: Written test followed by an interview. Check the official notice for details.†
rimc.eligibility: Check the RIMC notice for age and class rules.†
rimc.leads: Schooling at RIMC, then the NDA route

lsat.name: LSAT-India
lsat.simple: A law entrance test accepted by some private law universities.
lsat.pattern: Multiple-choice test of reasoning and reading. Check the current LSAC India notice.†
lsat.eligibility: Class 12 pass for the 5-year law courses. Each college sets its own rules.
lsat.leads: 5-year law courses at colleges that accept it

ssc-cgl.name: SSC CGL
ssc-cgl.simple: The test for many central government officer jobs after a degree.
ssc-cgl.month: Notice around May to June; Tier 1 around August to September; Tier 2 later in the year (2026 cycle)
ssc-cgl.marking: Wrong answers lose marks. Check the official notice for the exact deduction.†
ssc-cgl.eligibility: A degree from a recognised university. Age limits depend on the post, mostly between 18 and 32. Relaxation for SC/ST, OBC and PwBD. Some posts need Maths or Statistics.
ssc-cgl.leads: Central government jobs such as Inspector, Assistant Section Officer and Auditor

ibps-po.name: IBPS PO (bank officer)
ibps-po.simple: The test to become a bank probationary officer.
ibps-po.month: Prelims about August, Mains about October (2026 cycle)
ibps-po.pattern: Three stages: Prelims, Mains and Interview. Section details and marks change, so read the official notice.†
ibps-po.eligibility: A degree in any subject from a recognised university. Age about 20 to 30 years, with relaxation for reserved categories.
ibps-po.leads: Probationary Officer jobs in public sector banks

rrb-ntpc.name: RRB NTPC (railways, graduate level)
rrb-ntpc.simple: The test for graduate-level jobs in Indian Railways.
rrb-ntpc.month: Check the RRB notice (2026 notice came in September)
rrb-ntpc.mode: Computer based, then skill test or aptitude test
rrb-ntpc.pattern: Two computer based tests (CBT 1 and CBT 2), then a typing or skill test, document checks and a medical test. The pattern can change.†
rrb-ntpc.eligibility: A degree from a recognised university. Age about 18 to 33 years, with relaxation for reserved categories.†
rrb-ntpc.leads: Railway posts such as Station Master, Goods Guard and Clerk

kpsc-kas.name: KPSC KAS (Karnataka officer)
kpsc-kas.simple: The state test to become a Karnataka government officer.
kpsc-kas.month: Prelims planned for November 2026 (dates can change)
kpsc-kas.pattern: Three stages: Preliminary exam, Main exam and Interview. Check the KPSC notice for papers and marks.†
kpsc-kas.eligibility: A degree from a recognised university and a Kannada language rule. Age limits differ by category. Read the notice.†
kpsc-kas.leads: Posts such as Assistant Commissioner, Tahsildar and Deputy Superintendent of Police

cat.name: CAT (IIM MBA)
cat.body: IIMs, run by IIM Indore for 2026
cat.simple: The test for MBA at the IIMs and many top business schools.
cat.marking: +3 for a correct MCQ and -1 for a wrong MCQ. No negative marking for typed answers.†
cat.eligibility: A degree with at least 50% marks (45% for SC/ST/PwD). Final-year students can apply.†
cat.leads: MBA or PGDM at the IIMs and other business schools

cmat.name: CMAT (MBA)
cmat.simple: A national test for MBA seats at many colleges.
cmat.month: Around January to February 2027 (check the NTA notice)
cmat.pattern: Five sections of 20 questions each: Quantitative Techniques and Data Interpretation, Logical Reasoning, Language Comprehension, General Awareness, and Innovation and Entrepreneurship.
cmat.marking: +4 for correct and -1 for wrong. Nothing for unattempted.
cmat.eligibility: A degree from a recognised university. No age limit. Final-year students can apply.
cmat.leads: MBA seats at colleges that accept CMAT

ugc-net.name: UGC NET
ugc-net.simple: The test to become a college lecturer or get a research fellowship.
ugc-net.pattern: Two papers in one session: Paper 1 (teaching and research aptitude) and Paper 2 (your subject). 150 questions and 300 marks.†
ugc-net.eligibility: A master's degree with about 55% marks (check the notice for reserved categories).†
ugc-net.leads: Assistant Professor posts and Junior Research Fellowship

kset.name: KSET (Karnataka lecturer test)
kset.simple: The Karnataka test to become a college lecturer.
kset.pattern: Paper 1 and Paper 2 in a single session, with many subject papers.†
kset.eligibility: A master's degree with at least 55% (50% for reserved categories). Final-year master's students can apply with conditions.
kset.leads: Assistant Professor posts in Karnataka colleges

gate.name: GATE (BE or BTech, then M.Tech)
gate.body: IIT Madras for 2027, on behalf of IITs and IISc
gate.simple: The test for M.Tech at top colleges and for some company jobs.
gate.pattern: About 30 test papers. You choose your subject paper. Check the GATE website for marks.†
gate.eligibility: Completed or studying in the 3rd or final year of a BE or BTech degree (or equal).
gate.leads: M.Tech at IITs and NITs, and some public sector jobs. The score is valid for 3 years.

neet-pg.name: NEET PG
neet-pg.body: National Board of Examinations in Medical Sciences (NBEMS)
neet-pg.simple: The test for specialist doctor (MD or MS) seats after MBBS.
neet-pg.pattern: Multiple-choice questions on medicine. The count is reported differently, so read the bulletin.†
neet-pg.eligibility: An MBBS degree, finishing the 1-year internship by the cut-off date, and a medical council registration.
neet-pg.leads: MD or MS seats, then specialist doctor

sat.name: SAT (study in the USA and more)
sat.simple: The test for many bachelor's degrees in the USA and some other countries.
sat.month: Check the College Board dates for India
sat.pattern: Reading and Writing, and Maths. Scored from 400 to 1600.
sat.eligibility: Usually taken in Class 11 or 12. Each university sets its own score needs.

ielts.name: IELTS (English test)
ielts.simple: An English test needed for studying or working in many countries.
ielts.month: Book a date that suits your application
ielts.mode: Computer or paper (paper is being phased out)†
ielts.pattern: Four parts: Listening, Reading, Writing and Speaking. About 2 hours 45 minutes. Each part is scored from 0 to 9.
ielts.eligibility: Open to all. Each university sets its own band score.
ielts.leads: Studying or working in English-speaking countries. Fees change, so check IDP India before booking.

ssc-chsl.name: SSC CHSL
ssc-chsl.simple: The test for clerk and assistant jobs after Class 12.
ssc-chsl.month: Once a year, check the SSC calendar
ssc-chsl.pattern: Computer based tests in stages. Check the notice for papers and marks.†
ssc-chsl.eligibility: Class 12 pass. Age limits depend on the post.†
ssc-chsl.leads: Clerk, Postal Assistant and Data Entry Operator posts

rrb-groupd.name: RRB Group D
rrb-groupd.simple: The test for helper and track posts in Indian Railways.
rrb-groupd.pattern: Computer based test, then a physical test, document checks and a medical test.†
rrb-groupd.eligibility: Class 10 pass or ITI. Age limits and fitness rules apply.†
rrb-groupd.leads: Track Maintainer, Helper and Assistant posts in railways

rrb-alp.name: RRB ALP (train driver)
rrb-alp.simple: The test to become an assistant loco pilot, the person who drives trains.
rrb-alp.pattern: Computer based tests, an aptitude test and a medical test.†
rrb-alp.eligibility: Class 10 plus ITI, or a diploma in a related trade. Age and eyesight rules apply.†
rrb-alp.leads: Assistant Loco Pilot and then Loco Pilot

ibps-clerk.name: IBPS Clerk
ibps-clerk.simple: The test for bank clerk jobs after a degree.
ibps-clerk.month: Once a year, check the IBPS calendar
ibps-clerk.pattern: Prelims and Mains, both computer based.†
ibps-clerk.eligibility: A degree in any subject. Age about 20 to 28 years, with relaxation for reserved categories.†
ibps-clerk.leads: Clerk jobs in public sector banks

ksp-police.name: Karnataka Police recruitment
ksp-police.simple: Tests to join the Karnataka police as a constable or sub-inspector.
ksp-police.pattern: Written test, physical tests and document checks. Sub-inspector posts add a main exam.†
ksp-police.eligibility: Constable: usually Class 12 pass. Sub-inspector: a degree. Height, age and fitness rules apply.†

india-post.name: India Post GDS
india-post.simple: Jobs as postmen and branch postmasters in villages.
india-post.pattern: Selection is based on Class 10 marks. Check the notice.†
india-post.eligibility: Class 10 pass with Maths and English. Basic computer skills and cycling or two-wheeler skills help.†
